title: Understand monthly text credits and optional credit packs
summary: Track included usage, prepaid balances and credit purchases shown for your account.

sections.title: How text credits work
sections.body: Included text credits reset monthly, including on yearly subscriptions. Message length and destination affect usage; one client notification can require more than one text segment. Routine operational email notifications are included separately. Automatic credit purchases are off.

sections.title: Review usage
sections.body:
1. Open **Subscription & billing → Overview** and check **Text credits** in **Your usage**.
2. Open **Plan** and, if available, review **Text allowance & extra credits**.
3. Read included credits used this month and the prepaid balance separately.
4. If your account offers a credit pack, select **Add** followed by its credit amount and price. Read **Add text credits** before selecting **Continue to secure payment**.
5. Credits are added only after the payment is verified. Use **Check text payment** for a pending purchase.

sections.title: Availability and delivery
sections.body: Credit packs appear only when an approved offer is available for your account. Do not assume every business has a buy button. Prepaid credits carry over while the billing account is retained. Buying credits does not override client consent, STOP requests, channel pauses or delivery problems.

sections.title: If credits or messages are pending
sections.body: Do not repurchase a pack just because a payment is awaiting verification. Read the saved status and contact support if needed. Use Notifications delivery history to investigate an individual message; a balance alone does not prove a message reached the client.
